daily.today_energy: Saturn's retrograde in your sign is finally showing you what needs restructuring. With the Sun trine this placement, you're getting real clarity on your direction without the usual friction. Trust what feels solid.
daily.love: Moon in Leo wants drama, but Venus square that energy might create some tension in how you're expressing affection. Keep it real instead of performative. Someone who appreciates your authentic self is worth more anyway.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter is amplifying your drive and ambition across the board. Channel that into something concrete today—this isn't just hype, it's actual momentum. Your next move has real potential.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding activities today. Mars in Virgo appreciates the details of a solid routine. Skip the overcomplication and focus on basics: hydration, movement, rest. Simple works.

weekly.overview: This week kicks off with Mars conjunct Jupiter in Leo—major amplification energy that hits you hard since Mars rules your chart. By midweek, the Moon trine Mars fuels momentum, but watch the Sun square Mars on the 24th; that's when ego and action collide. Best Day: Nov 26. Watch-Out Day: Nov 24. Saturn retrograde in your sign keeps asking what needs restructuring.
weekly.love: Early week feels magnetic—Venus sextile Jupiter softens your edges and makes you genuinely fun to be around. If you're coupled, this is flirting energy without trying. Single? People notice. Midweek might feel pushy or intense (Sun square Mars), so dial back the intensity. By the weekend, you're magnetic again as the Moon slides into Leo.
weekly.career: Mars shifting into Virgo late week is your signal to get organized. Right now, that Mars-Jupiter conjunction in Leo makes you bold—maybe too bold. Big ideas? Great. Presenting them? Wait until after the 24th when the intensity settles. This is prep week. Strategize, refine, execute next week when Mercury cooperates more.
weekly.health: High-octane energy all week means you need outlets—gym, running, something that burns off that Mars-Jupiter fire. The Sun square Mars on the 24th might trigger headaches or restlessness; hydrate and move intentionally. By the weekend, channel that Leo Moon into activities you actually enjoy, not just grind mode.
